issue: Every Surfpool differential compared the prepared fixtures with the original and candidate runs positionally using zip, which stops at the shortest sequence. No runner bound the three lengths, so a run that returned fewer rows than it was given was compared only up to its length and could report no mismatches.
affected: scripts/*_surfpool.py: the zip(left, prepared), zip(left, right), zip(fixtures, x, y) and zip(x, prepared) comparisons, none preceded by a length check
finding: Each runner builds `prepared` from the selected cases, then receives `left`/`right` (or `x`/`y`) from two independent Surfpool runs. The comparisons derive `mismatches` and `unexpected_original_errors` from those zips and the runner exits 0 when both are empty; `signed_transactions` in the receipt is the only witness of a short run, and nothing asserts it equals twice the case count.

change.helper: scripts/surfpool_recording_vm.py gains require_aligned_runs(prepared, left, right), which raises ValueError('surfpool runs do not cover the same cases: ...') unless all three lengths agree
change.call_sites: all sixteen scripts/*_surfpool.py call it once, immediately after the candidate run and before any comparison or raw-transaction receipt
change.unchanged_behaviour: case preparation, the Surfpool invocation, normalization, mismatch classification, receipt fields and exit statuses

cases: equal runs, including empty runs, are admitted
a short candidate run, a short original run and an empty original run are refused
every scripts/*_surfpool.py calls the guard exactly once
tests.before: FAILED (errors=1): the helper does not exist on the base revision

limits: This refuses a comparison the runners already could not support; it adds no case, no run and no Surfpool behavior, and changes no capture or prior receipt. It does not claim that a failed Surfpool request can be recovered: the refusal is the intended outcome.
